title: Health Resort west wing room 216 key

infobox.usage: Unlocks room 216 of the West wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort west wing room 216 key (W216 San) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium west wing room 216.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text:
- In a key rack in west wing room 202 at the health resort.

- On the floor below a key rack in the utility room next to west wing room 227 at the health resort.

- On the desk in the office with the broken door on the second floor of the administration building at the health resort.

- On a table in the hallway opposite east wing room 227 at the health resort.

- In the key rack near the central stairs on the second floor of the east wing at the health resort.

- On the floor below a key rack near the central stairs on the third floor of the east wing at the health resort.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The second floor, room 216 of the West Wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Weapon box (6x2)
- 2x Weapon box (4x4)
- 2x Grenade box
- 1x weapon spawn M4A1
- Loose loot (Electronics, Meds, Medical supplies, Provisions, loaded GEN M3 Magazines)
- 1x LEDX Spawn
